summary:
Phase 11 complete. Added `renovate.json` with shared-preset consumption, explicit PEP 621 selection, and Renovate-managed pip-audit 2.10.1; added the weekly/manual Python audit workflow; added `docs/dependency-automation.md`; and linked guidance from README/AGENTS while preserving the pre-existing AGENTS checkstyle edit. No dependency constraints, test code, credentials, or live API behavior changed.

Validation passed: Node 24.20.0/npm 11.19.0, strict Renovate schema, actionlint, whitespace/credential checks, and credential-free Renovate extraction of 19 records from three files. The exact workflow blocks ran successfully in an isolated Python 3.12 environment and audited all 34 installed third-party packages. pip-audit reported seven records across six unique advisories for pip 24.0; findings remained non-blocking while completeness checks passed. Ruff, strict mypy, collection of 130 tests without network preflight, and OpenAPI coverage with 43 covered operations and no missing/placeholders also passed.

Unbounded requirements remain unpinned and produce no fabricated update PRs; reinstallations are time-specific rather than reproducible historical environments. Published-preset resolution, GitHub Action/Python lookups—the local anonymous Python lookup hit HTTP 403 rate limiting—hosted audit execution, dependency graph/Dependabot settings, and activation remain pending Phase 12 with operator actions and expected evidence documented in `docs/dependency-automation.md`.
